name: Ink-Wash Mountains
desc: Receding sumi-e mountain ridges in tonal washes and broken dry-brush crests, banks of fog drifting between them while a lone boat crosses the water over minutes beneath a vermilion seal.

style.doc: aesthetic: brushed tonal washes w/ dry-brush crest / white schematic contour lines on cyanotype (abstract) / glowing outline ridges on near-black

act.doc: multi-minute program: voyage a slow crossing, moor holds near center, storm brings raking rain
